Encapsulates base runtime components for simplification of base bundle.

class ats_utilities.base.setup.bundle.BaseBundle(*, context_bundle: ContextBundle, info_manager: IInfoManager, option_manager: IOptionManager, splash_manager: ISplashManager, generation_manager: IGeneratorManager | None)[source]¶

Bases: object

Encapsulates base runtime components for simplification of base bundle.

It defines:

attributes:
